name: fuse-protocol
description: FUSE 引信协议 — frontend + Cloudflare Worker backend

scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd worker && ./node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate: cd worker && ./node_modules/.bin/wrangler d1 migrations apply fuse-protocol --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: cd worker && ./node_modules/.bin/wrangler d1 migrations apply fuse-protocol --local
